examples.name: Sample — xx
paragraphs: An NAIC rate-filing exhibit where every row after the first is a blank template row awaiting entry — the structure is the content. Each blank row still prints XX and the computed 0.00% / 0.00 subtotals, and all nine are kept. Each column header is one label wrapped over many lines, so its lines are joined into one cell, including the words broken mid-word by the narrow columns.

examples.name: Sample — a court scheduling order
paragraphs: SCHEDULING AND CUTOFF DATES: three columns, nine rows, every row's description printed and its two date cells empty. The banner above the header row is a title band inside the frame.

snippets.text:
**IT IS HEREBY ORDERED** that the parties and their respective counsel shall comply with the following schedule, and that Sanctions, including but not limited to those set forth in the Local Court Rules may be imposed for noncompliance.
SCHEDULING AND CUTOFF DATES
DAYS PRIOR TO TRIAL DATE DESCRIPTION
Disclosure of possible primary witnesses
Disclosure of possible additional witnesses
Discovery cutoff
Settlement Conference
Last day to hear Dispositive Pretrial Motions
Exchange of Witness and Exhibit Lists
Joint Statement of the Evidence
Filing of Trial Briefs
TRIAL to begin at 9:00 a.m.
